values.note: Every site $30 (2026 and 2027 rate tables). A Smokies parking tag ($5 day, $15 week, $40 year) is not needed for vehicles parked at the reserved site, but is for vehicles beyond what the site allows and for parking anywhere else in the park; interagency passes don't replace it.

fees.source: recreation.gov rate table for 232479; NPS GSMNP fees page; recreation.gov parking-tag notice; read 2026-11-24

note: Mostly a tent campground: only 17 sites take an RV or trailer (A01-A03, A17, A20, A21, A23, A25, A28, A36, A42, A57, A59, A61; B75, B88, B93); the van/compact-camper sites A11, B20, B34-35 and B58 do not. Reserve online, same day included; no cash at the office, and check in with staff on arrival. --Claude
